clue.text: London landmark lady matriarch constructed

indicators.note: something constructed is built from parts, so these letters are assembled into a new order

explanation.surface: A formidable woman at the head of her family had a famous London building put up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constructed' looks like the verb of a sentence about a woman building something, but it is the anagram signal. The landmark is the grand triple gateway between Trafalgar Square and The Mall.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: it is a famous ceremonial gateway at the end of The Mall, near Trafalgar Square.

clue.text: Ace thrilled with rap music trophy

indicators.note: someone thrilled is excited and agitated, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A star performer is delighted to win an award for hip-hop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrilled' is the anagram signal, and 'with' simply joins the two parts of the fodder, ACE and RAP MUSIC. The trophy is for sailing, not music.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: it is the oldest prize in international yacht racing.

clue.text: Precocious girl of 24's language: that's tasty all round!

indicators.note: all round says the sound of relish goes on both sides of the coding language

parts.note: MM is what you say when food is delicious
24 across is someone who writes code, and Ada is a language for writing code

explanation.surface: A forward young girl speaks the way someone at number 24 does, to general delight.
explanation.walkthrough: '24' is a cross-reference to the answer at 24 across, a writer of code, not a house number. 'all round' wraps the sound of relish about that person's language.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: in British English a 'little' one is a bossy, forward young girl.

clue.text: Marketing ploy of a number that's taken in wrong spirit

indicators.note: the number has taken in the other two pieces, so it holds them inside itself

parts.note: reg is British shorthand for a car's registration number
bad means wrong, as in bad behaviour
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: A sales trick involving a figure that people have received with ill will.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's taken in' puts BAD GIN inside REG. REG is British shorthand for a vehicle's registration number, as in 'a 2018 reg'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: selling the same product under a new brand name is a classic sales trick.

clue.text: Coming to blows with general over charge

indicators.note: in a down clue, over places the general's name above the piece that follows

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general in the American Civil War
a ward is a person in someone's charge, as a guardian has

explanation.surface: Someone gets into a fist fight with an army commander about a fee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' puts LEE above WARD in this down entry. The definition is whimsical: not a fight, but the side towards which the wind blows.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword-only sense: it describes the sheltered side, the direction towards which the wind is heading.

clue.text: Rustic couple on lake

indicators.note: in a down clue, on places the first piece on top of the letter for lake

parts.note: to yoke two oxen is to couple them together
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A pair from the countryside are out on the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' stacks YOKE above L in this down entry. 'couple' is a verb here, not a pair of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym as a noun: an unsophisticated country person.

clue.text: They're OK for cars, for transporting

definitions.text: They're OK for cars, for transporting

indicators.note: transporting carries things from place to place, so the letters are carried to new positions

explanation.surface: Something suitable for vehicles, used when carrying loads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transporting' is the anagram signal for OK FOR CARS, and the whole clue also describes the answer, so it serves as the definition too.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: these are frames fitted on top of a vehicle to carry luggage or bicycles.

clue.text: Bears in the wood with horse coming up

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up lifts the letter for horse to the top of the word

parts.note: ash is a kind of wood, from the ash tree
H is slang for heroin, as is horse

explanation.surface: Wild animals in a forest as a rider approaches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' lifts the H of ASH from the bottom to the top of this down entry. 'Bears' is a verb: a tree bears fruit when it carries it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym as a verb: a woman who bears a child gives birth to one, as in 'she bears him a son'.

clue.text: Pocket: area of snooker table for pot

parts.note: pocket as an adjective means small, like a pocket dictionary, and wee is Scots for small
the D is the semicircle at one end of a snooker table from which play starts

explanation.surface: A description of where to sink a ball on a snooker table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pocket' is an adjective meaning small, and the D is the marked semicircle on a snooker table. 'pot' is slang for cannabis, not sinking a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang synonym: both are informal names for cannabis.

clue.text: Work of British parliament covering security breach

indicators.note: covering says the two outer pieces together go round the breach

parts.note: a house is a chamber of a parliament, as in the House of Commons
a leak is a breach of security in which secrets get out

explanation.surface: MPs at Westminster are busy dealing with a lapse in national security.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Work' wants to be a verb, what a parliament does; it is a noun, a novel by Charles Dickens. 'covering' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: it is a Dickens novel about an endless lawsuit.

clue.text: Compromise, going by sea, returning first class

parts.note: via means going by way of
the Med is the Mediterranean Sea

indicators.note: returning sends the two letters for first class back the way they came

parts.note: AI looks like A1, meaning first class

explanation.surface: A deal is struck: travel out by ship and come home in the best seats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns AI into IA. A1, written AI, is the crossword convention for first class. The answer is Latin for 'middle way'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the Latin phrase means a middle way between two extremes.

clue.text: Popular singer comes before poet

indicators.note: comes before says the bird goes ahead of the word for popular

parts.note: a lark is a songbird
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A chart-topping vocalist goes on stage ahead of a writer of verse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes before' reverses the clue's order of the two pieces. The singer is a bird, not a pop star; Philip of that name was a twentieth-century English poet.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Philip of that name wrote 'The Whitsun Weddings'.

clue.text: I seize promotion without difficulty: that's viewed unfavourably

parts.note: to nab is to seize or grab
an ad is a promotion for a product
light work is easy work, done with no trouble

explanation.surface: Someone grabs a better job easily, and colleagues disapprove.
explanation.walkthrough: 'promotion' is an advert, not a step up at work. The four pieces simply run in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: something seen this way is shown so that it looks worse than it is.

clue.text: Football body's second tier director

parts.note: the FA is the Football Association, which runs English football, and the possessive adds the S
read as tie-er, one who ties, which is what a binder does

explanation.surface: A board member of a club in football's lower division.
explanation.walkthrough: The FA is England's Football Association. 'tier' is not a level but someone who ties. Rainer Werner of this name was a German film director.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Rainer Werner of this name made German films such as 'The Marriage of Maria Braun'.

clue.text: Mark coming soon to open street party

indicators.note: to open the street is to split its abbreviation and go inside

parts.note: to tag something is to mark or label it
nigh means near in time, as in the end is nigh

explanation.surface: A man called Mark will shortly kick off a neighbourhood celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' is capitalised to look like a man's name but is a verb, to label. 'to open' is the container signal. The answer is the British name for a bachelor party.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: it is the celebration a groom has with his male friends before the wedding.

clue.text: Single minded about success, ultimately display timidity

indicators.note: about says the first two pieces together go round the single letter

parts.note: in cricket a single is one run
to have minded is to have cared, as in 'I never minded'

indicators.note: ultimately takes the final letter of the word after it

explanation.surface: Someone totally focused on winning ends up showing fear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Single minded' reads as one phrase but must be split: a single is one run in cricket. 'ultimately' picks a last letter and 'about' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to behave in a frightened, over-cautious way.

clue.text: Cove hidden by beach — a pity

indicators.note: hidden by says the answer lies concealed inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A lovely inlet can't be seen from the sands, which is a shame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hidden by' shows the answer lies inside 'beach a pity'. Cove is old British slang for a man, not a small bay.
explanation.definitionFit: Old slang synonym: both are informal British words for a fellow.

clue.text: Minutes or seconds from nasty accident, steps back

indicators.note: seconds from takes the second letter of each of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Moments away from a horrible crash, someone moves away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seconds from' takes the second letter of each of the four words after it. The minutes are a written record, not units of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the Latin word for the official record of a meeting's proceedings.

clue.text: Reason old woman needs new park keeper

parts.note: grounds for a decision are the reason for it
old woman is slang for one's mother, or ma

explanation.surface: An elderly lady explains why the gardens want a fresh warden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs' just joins the pieces. 'old woman' is slang for mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Near synonym: someone employed to look after a sports field or public gardens.

clue.text: Four, maybe, twisting one's arm

definitions.note: a four is a rowing crew of four, so the answer is a plural

indicators.note: twisting wrenches something out of shape, so the letters are wrenched into a new order

explanation.surface: Perhaps as many as four people are bending someone's limb to persuade them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisting' is the anagram signal for ONE'S ARM. A four is a rowing boat's crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a four is a crew of rowers in a racing boat.

clue.text: Did state nursing languish in misuse of drug?

indicators.note: in says the word for languish sits inside the letters for the drug misuse

parts.note: an OD is an overdose
to pine is to languish with longing

explanation.surface: Was public healthcare left to waste away amid a medication scandal?
explanation.walkthrough: 'state nursing' suggests public healthcare, but 'state' is a verb, to say, and 'Did' makes it past tense. 'in' is the container signal; the misuse of a drug is an overdose.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to have given a view is to have said or declared it.

clue.text: Girl in papers upset by gossip

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset overturns the letters for papers

parts.note: ID is identity papers
ana is a collection of anecdotes or gossip about a person

explanation.surface: A young woman featured in the press is distressed by rumours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns ID into DI. ANA is a crossword favourite meaning a collection of gossip or anecdotes.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: it is a female first name.

clue.text: After travelling, reach old English town

indicators.note: travelling means moving about, so the letters that follow have moved to new places

explanation.surface: At the end of a journey you arrive at a historic place in England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After travelling' is the anagram signal for REACH OLD. The answer is a town in Greater Manchester.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: it is a former mill town near Manchester.

clue.text: Stop work in kitchen

definitions.meaning: to stop talking, as an actor does on forgetting the lines
to wipe washed dishes with a tea towel, as the British say

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to fall silent, and in British usage to wipe the washed dishes.

clue.text: Provider of instructions for golf: driver needed

parts.note: pro means in favour of, or for
Golf stands for G in the radio alphabet
a rammer drives things in by force

explanation.surface: A golf coach says which club to use off the tee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' gives PRO, though it looks like a link word. The instructions are code for a computer.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: someone who writes the code that tells a computer what to do.

clue.text: Character of Greek cowherd turning up off and on

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the chosen letters from the bottom
off and on means skipping one letter and taking the next, through the word

explanation.surface: A figure from Greek myth, a cattle drover, appears now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off and on' takes alternate letters of cowherd, OHR, and 'turning up' reads them from the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: it is the seventeenth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Welcome private practitioner holding various positions

parts.note: yo is an informal greeting
a GI is an ordinary American soldier, a private

explanation.surface: Greet a doctor outside the public system who has several different jobs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'private' is a soldier, an American GI. The positions are poses, not jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: someone devoted to an Indian discipline of bodily poses and meditation.

clue.text: Exclamation from lady in theatre exposed mother and boy, observe

parts.note: a secret that is out has been exposed
a dam is the mother of a horse or other animal
Ned is a boy's name
to spot something is to observe it

explanation.surface: A woman in the audience cries out on seeing a parent and son revealed on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: The lady is Lady Macbeth, who cries this while sleepwalking and trying to wash imagined blood from her hands.
explanation.definitionFit: Quotation: Lady Macbeth's cry in Shakespeare's play as she scrubs at imagined blood.
